operations.name: generate
operations.description: Single-turn or multi-turn text generation via the Messages API. max_tokens is required by this endpoint (Anthropic has no server-side default) — a caller-supplied value is always forwarded as-is; this connector applies no capping or clamping of its own.

data_flows: input.messages (including any input.messages entries with role 'system') and input.model/max_tokens/temperature are sent, as JSON, to provider.base_url (or its base_url_override_env override, when explicitly configured) over HTTPS.
No data is sent anywhere else — there is no secondary destination, logging sink, or analytics call in this connector.
The provider's full raw response is returned to the caller unmodified as output.raw; nothing is dropped, redacted, or summarized before being handed back.
